section.content: 本实用新型涉及种生物基因仪器构件，包括主体箱和辅助箱，所述主体箱与辅助箱之间安装有限位板，所述主体箱上分别安装有导轨、限位块和空心管，所述限位块和空心管安装在导轨的两端，所述辅助箱上分别安装有电控盒、电源盒和备用盒，所述电源盒与电控盒通过穿线管相连接，所述备用盒位于电控盒的右端，所述限位块的正下方安装有拓展板。本实用新型通过设置导轨、限位块、空心管和电控盒既有助于安装移动部件并限制移动部件的位置又有助于穿接导线盒及安装电控元件，通过设置电源盒和备用盒有助于安装供电元件和放置辅助器具。

The utility model relates to a biological gene instrument component, including main part case and auxiliary tank, install the limiting plate between main part case and the auxiliary tank, install guide rail, stopper and hollow tube on the main part case respectively, the both ends at the guide rail are installed to stopper and hollow tube, install automatically controlled box, power pack and reserve box on the auxiliary tank respectively, the power pack is connected through the threading pipe with automatically controlled box, reserve box is located the right -hand member of automatically controlled box, install the expansion board under the stopper.
